# Assist reply (`assist-reply`)

What the voice assistant understood and did, with the things it changed and an undo.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createAssistReply` (types in `dist/web/home/media-voice/assistReply.d.ts`): `.mh-assist-reply` (`.is-error`): what a voice assistant understood and did, as a labelled group. `__heard` (the recognised words, with a hidden "You said"), `__reply` (a polite live region, so an updated answer is read out), a `__changes` list of `__change` rows (a `__badge` icon lit like a control card's, `__name`, `__state`; `.is-active`, `.is-failed`, tones `--warm | --heat | --cool`) and a `__footer` with the `__undo` button (`aria-busy` while undoing) or, once undone, the `__undone` note.

```ts
export function createAssistReply(options: AssistReplyOptions): AssistReplyHandle;

export interface AssistReplyOptions extends AssistReplyData {
  /** Puts the changes back; without it there is no undo button. */
  onUndo?: () => void;
}

export interface AssistReplyHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  update(options: AssistReplyOptions): void;
}

export interface AssistReplyData {
  /** The words that were recognised. */
  heard?: string | null;
  /** What the assistant answered. */
  reply?: string | null;
  changes?: readonly AssistReplyChange[];
  /** The assistant couldn't do it: the reply takes the danger colour. */
  error?: boolean;
  /** The undo is running: the button shows a spinner. */
  undoing?: boolean;
  /** The changes were undone: the button gives way to a note. */
  undone?: boolean;
  /** Accessible name (default "Assistant"). */
  label?: string;
  labels?: Partial<AssistReplyLabels>;
}

/** Every word the reply shows or speaks. */
export interface AssistReplyLabels {
  group: string;
  heard: string;
  changes: string;
  failed: string;
  undo: string;
  undone: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { mdiBlindsHorizontal, mdiCeilingLight } from '@mdi/js';
import { createAssistReply, type AssistReplyOptions } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const answer: AssistReplyOptions = {
  heard: 'Turn off the living room lights and close the blinds',
  reply: 'Done. I turned off 2 lights and closed the blinds.',
  changes: [
    { id: 'ceiling', name: 'Ceiling light', icon: mdiCeilingLight, state: 'Off' },
    { id: 'lamp', name: 'Reading lamp', icon: 'lightbulb', state: 'Off' },
    { id: 'blinds', name: 'Living room blinds', icon: mdiBlindsHorizontal, state: 'Closing', active: true },
  ],
};

const undo = (): void => {
  reply.update({ ...answer, undoing: true });
  setTimeout(
    () =>
      reply.update({
        ...answer,
        undone: true,
        changes: [
          { id: 'ceiling', name: 'Ceiling light', icon: mdiCeilingLight, state: 'On', active: true, tone: 'warm' },
          { id: 'lamp', name: 'Reading lamp', icon: 'lightbulb', state: 'On', active: true, tone: 'warm' },
          { id: 'blinds', name: 'Living room blinds', icon: mdiBlindsHorizontal, state: 'Open' },
        ],
      }),
    900,
  );
};

const reply = createAssistReply({ ...answer, onUndo: undo });

document.body.append(reply.el);
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { mdiBlindsHorizontal, mdiCeilingLight } from '@mdi/js';
import { AssistReply } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

type Stage = 'done' | 'undoing' | 'undone';

export function AssistReplyExample() {
  const [stage, setStage] = useState<Stage>('done');
  const undone = stage === 'undone';
  const light = undone ? { state: 'On', active: true, tone: 'warm' as const } : { state: 'Off' };
  const undo = () => {
    setStage('undoing');
    setTimeout(() => setStage('undone'), 900);
  };
  return (
    <AssistReply
      heard="Turn off the living room lights and close the blinds"
      reply="Done. I turned off 2 lights and closed the blinds."
      changes={[
        { id: 'ceiling', name: 'Ceiling light', icon: mdiCeilingLight, ...light },
        { id: 'lamp', name: 'Reading lamp', icon: 'lightbulb', ...light },
        { id: 'blinds', name: 'Blinds', icon: mdiBlindsHorizontal, state: undone ? 'Open' : 'Closing' },
      ]}
      undoing={stage === 'undoing'}
      undone={undone}
      onUndo={undo}
    />
  );
}
```
